groups.title: Multi-agent task aggregation
groups.intro: Records from every agent in one task are merged by time; progress, elapsed time and stuck agents all come from the server aggregate.
groups.offline: No server connection: the aggregate view needs server answers and will not substitute sample data.
groups.list.title: Task groups
groups.create.title: New task group
groups.create.field.title: Title
groups.create.required: Fill in a title and at least one agent ID.
groups.detail.empty: Pick a task group from the list above.
groups.progress.title: Progress
groups.progress.label: {done} done / {running} running / {needs_me} need a human / {total} total
groups.resources.title: Resources
groups.agents.title: Agents
groups.stuck.title: Stuck agents
groups.timeline.title: Merged timeline

groups.timeline.filter.hint: Untick an agent to hide its rows.
groups.timeline.no_match: No record matches the current filter.

groups.error.group_field_invalid: A task group field is not valid.

sharing.title: Sharing and collaboration
sharing.intro: Share a task group with other users: the link is shown once, and a view-only role gets no approval control here.
sharing.offline: No server connection: the share lists and permissions come from the server, so the page shows no substitute data.
sharing.group.label: Choose a task group
sharing.group.empty: No task group is available to share yet.
sharing.group.title: Task groups and sharing
sharing.share.title: Share
sharing.share.permission.view.hint: Read only: no approvals and no managing.
sharing.share.permission.approve.hint: Can approve interventions; cannot manage sharing.
sharing.share.permission.manage.hint: Can manage sharing and approve as well.
sharing.share.ttl.hint: Defaults to 86400 seconds; the link stops working afterwards.
sharing.share.result.warning: This is a plaintext token shown exactly once; it cannot be read again after you close this panel, so copy it now.
sharing.share.result.no_token: The server returned no plaintext token. That does not mean the share failed; check the issued list.
sharing.share.required: Enter the TTL as a positive whole number of seconds.
sharing.issued.title: Issued by me
sharing.issued.empty: You have not issued a share yet.
sharing.issued.revoke_confirm: Revoke this share? The link stops working immediately.
sharing.shared.title: Shared with me
sharing.shared.empty: Nobody has shared a task group with you yet.
sharing.accept.title: Accept a share
sharing.perms.title: What this role may do on the chosen group
sharing.perms.view_only: This role can only view: no approval or manage control is offered on this page.
sharing.perms.none: This role has no permission on the chosen group.
sharing.perms.need_group: Choose a task group to see its permissions.
sharing.error.share_permission_invalid: That share permission is not valid.
sharing.error.share_token_invalid: The share token is not valid.
sharing.error.share_token_used: That share token has already been used.
sharing.error.share_forbidden: This role may not perform that operation.
sharing.error.group_not_found: That task group does not exist.
sharing.share.invitee.hint: Leave empty: anyone holding this link may accept it.
sharing.share.copy.failed: The browser refused to copy: select the link and copy it manually.
sharing.issued.revoke.failed: Revoke refused: only the inviter, the group leader, or a group manager may revoke.
sharing.gate.title: What you may do in this task group
sharing.gate.leader: You lead this group: share, intervene, and rollback are available.
sharing.gate.hide.share: Share hidden: only the group leader or a group manager may start a share.
sharing.gate.hide.intervene: Intervene and rollback hidden: you hold view-only permission in this group.
sharing.gate.denied: The server refused that operation (insufficient permission): the controls are hidden; refresh to re-check.
sharing.onbehalf.title: On-behalf notes
sharing.onbehalf.hint: Purple marks come from the collaboration event ledger: who acted on whose behalf; final responsibility stays with the human owner.
sharing.onbehalf.detail: {actor} acted with {principal}’s permission; final responsibility stays with {principal}.
sharing.onbehalf.empty: No on-behalf operations in these records.
